systems.owner: Ministry of Education, State Department for Basic Education
systems.tiers: being operationalised on 28 August 2025 as the single source of education data across all levels; only schools with validated data to be activated on it
named as the system through which education data is collected; no description of what schools enter

systems.country_label: verification of education data for primary, junior and secondary schools
systems.platform: web forms at ee.education.go.ke, one link for heads of institutions and one for sub-county directors
systems.owner: Ministry of Education, through county and sub-county directors of education
systems.tiers: all primary, junior and secondary schools: school profile, head's profile, bank account details and learner numbers by grade, gender and special needs status, due by 5 September 2025

note: The circular describes only a one-off return of school details and enrolment counts as the prerequisite for onboarding onto KEMIS; it says nothing of a record per learner or of anything schools enter in NEMIS or KEMIS, so both are left unclassified and no fact is taken.
